card.title: The Ceremony Requires More
card.instruction: Treat every ordinary step as only the beginning of an elaborate ceremony, adding necessary details whenever anyone tries to finish.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your shoelace is tied. Now we bless the successful tying.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The bus is here. I'm finished.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The knot is finished. The departure requires a second knot.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Fine, I've double-knotted it. Can I go?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: After we formally introduce the two knots. They'll be travelling together.

mechanism: A turns a tied lace into a blessing, a departure knot and finally an introduction between knots as B seeks to leave.
confusable: Unlike merely slowing someone through anxiety, A invents ceremonial completion steps in response to each attempted finish.
comparison: The shoelace alternative adds relationship ceremony between completed knots; the candle alternative adds a new candle to acknowledge the previous one.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
